classes.INTERNAL_VERIFIED: Executable/configuration/runtime evidence may be certified when actually tested.
classes.PASS-EXTERNAL: Use only for a genuinely required external provider/service boundary after its real commissioning/test evidence; do not use when no external runtime service is required.
classes.PASS-ASSET: Use for physical device, OS/hardware, signing material or supplied production asset acceptance; it is an acceptance class, not a substitute for claiming an unperformed device test.
classes.PASS-HUMAN: Use for final human/device/store acceptance activities that cannot be truthfully automated; human acceptance is supplemental and never substitutes for automated regression.
classes.PASS-USER-TESTING: Legacy alias retained only for historical evidence; new records must use PASS-HUMAN.

prohibited: Do not invent endpoints, credentials, provider activation, asset evidence or human-testing PASS. Do not leave a dependency as an undefined OPEN blocker when it has been correctly classified as PASS-EXTERNAL, PASS-ASSET or PASS-HUMAN; record the exact execution evidence or acceptance protocol instead.
external_service_minimization: Internal-first; external runtime services are optional and disabled unless explicitly commissioned by Master Admin. CI infrastructure is build/test infrastructure, not a product runtime dependency.
